intent: Keep the wordmark alone in black space. Restrict the established moss accent to ZZ so the communication motif resolves into typography without becoming a network spectacle.
source:
**Frame:** Full-width black incident-wordmark panel. The lettering is dirty off-white; `ZZ` carries the quiet moss accent established by the board. No logo, robot, or network spectacle.

**Action:** The incident movement resolves into the book’s treatment of the opening request.

**Screen / system text:**
`ZZ: NO CONSUMER`

**Provenance:** `invented` — wordmark treatment is project design, derived from the documented [page-003](003.md) string.
title: The incident wordmark in black space
